title: BankingRiskScoringConfiguration
description: Risk scoring parameters, weights, and classification boundaries for core banking QA.

CRITICAL.description: Direct financial discrepancy, ledger imbalance, duplicate debit, data breach, or unauthorized transaction.

HIGH.description: Functional block in payment path, validation bypass, boundary limit error without money loss.

MEDIUM.description: UI/UX validation glitches, transient timeout without data loss, non-blocking notification issues.

LOW.description: Cosmetic defects, minor formatting, localization text inconsistencies.

financialImpact.10: Duplicate debit, incorrect account balance alteration, direct monetary theft/loss
financialImpact.8: Uncontrolled overdraft or limit overrun exceeding $1,000

accountingImpact.10: General ledger out-of-balance, un-reconciled debit without corresponding credit/suspense entry

securityRegulatoryImpact.10: Unauthenticated transfer, token bypass, unmasked PII in logs, AML/KYC evasion
securityRegulatoryImpact.7: Session hijacking vulnerability, weak entropy on transaction references

customerImpact.10: Customer funds locked without explanation, false debit notification
customerImpact.7: Failed transfer with confusing error message requiring branch visit

recoveryComplexity.10: Requires manual database intervention, wire recall, or external clearing reconciliation
recoveryComplexity.7: Requires automated manual batch saga reversal tool
